providers.title: AI providers
providers.description: Bochica needs at least one AI provider. Paste an API key, or use a model running on this computer. Keys are stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
providers.whereToGetKey: Where do I get my key?
providers.fromEnv: Using the key from the {{name}} environment variable. Save a key here to use a different one.
providers.localDescription: Runs on this computer at {{url}}. No key needed.

result.invalid: {{provider}} rejected this key. Check that you copied all of it, or create a new one.
result.network_error: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. Check your internet connection and try again.
result.localUnreachable: {{provider}} isn't answering. Make sure it is running on this computer.
result.error: {{provider}} answered with error {{code}}. Try again in a few minutes.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This screen hit an unexpected error. Reloading usually fixes it; your keys and settings are safe.

chat.addProvider: Add an AI provider in Settings to start
chat.cutOff: The answer was cut off because it reached the length limit.

errors.missing_key: There is no API key for this provider. Add one in Settings.
errors.invalid_key: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and retry.
errors.model_not_found: This model is not available with your key. Choose another one.
errors.provider_unavailable: The provider is having problems right now. Retry in a few minutes.
errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and retry.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while answering. Retry, or open Details to see what happened.
